_comment: Optional overrides for gemini_workflow/lora_dataset_builder.py. Every key under 'profiles' is a --profile name; values are merged over the built-in DEFAULT_PROFILES. Copy the '_example' block to add a new character. Fields: game (caption token + folder group), character (danbooru-style tag), trigger (dataset/trigger word), repeat (kohya repeat prefix), dataset_group (folder under data/train_data), gender/identity/outfit (caption tag lists), identity_prompt/outfit_prompt (generation wording), must_keep (identity rules the prompt must state), avoid (extra negative wording), require_ahoge (reject shots where the ahoge is missing).

lohen.identity_prompt: short messy sage-green hair with soft spiky layered tufts and a long side-swept fringe over the forehead, DULL CRIMSON-RED eyes, one solid colour in BOTH eyes (never pink, magenta or purple; never a two-tone iris, never a green, cyan or white pupil or inner iris), a small beauty mark under his right eye (the viewer's left in a front view), a young-boy anime face with light skin
lohen.outfit_prompt: a white high-collared shirt with a silver and pale-blue winged emblem on the chest, a pale-blue corset-like vest with small diamond details and a dark diagonal chest strap, a long dark-navy coat with gold trim and silver arrow-shaped clasps, a short dark-navy half-cape with a light-blue lining and silver-and-gold shoulder pauldrons, black gloves with blue fingertips and a dark-navy bracer with gold trim, white trousers with a dark-navy thigh strap and a silver cross emblem, and tall dark-navy boots with silver armored toe caps
must_keep: the short dark-navy half-cape stays over the shoulders and never hides the chest emblem
the outfit keeps its white trousers and tall dark boots - never a skirt, shorts or bare legs
the eyes are one solid DULL CRIMSON RED in BOTH eyes - never pink, magenta or purple, never two different colours, and never a two-tone iris with a green, cyan or white pupil
lohen.eye_line: BOTH eyes are clearly visible and are one solid dull crimson red - never pink, magenta or purple, never a two-tone iris with a green or cyan pupil.

traits.expect: BOTH irises one solid dull crimson-red colour. 'wrong' if either iris is pink, magenta, purple or vivid scarlet, if the two eyes differ, or if the iris/pupil is two-tone (a green, cyan or white pupil or inner iris). 'partial' if the red base is right but a subtle greenish rim on the outer iris edge is missing - the rim is a bonus, never a requirement. 'unclear' if the eyes are too small or hidden to tell.
a small beauty mark (mole) under his right eye, which appears on the viewer's LEFT in a front view

durin.identity_prompt: short messy pale-lavender hair in layered spiky tufts, darker violet strands at the tips and long strands framing the face, TWO dark-grey SEGMENTED dragon horns that hook backwards like jagged crystalline blades, one on each side of the head, each horn edged with a faint violet-blue glow, a pair of dark bat-like dragon wings with magenta-red membrane folded behind his back, bright CRIMSON-ROSE eyes, one solid colour in BOTH eyes (never blue, green, gold or violet), a slender young-boy anime face with pale skin
durin.outfit_prompt: a black high-collared tailcoat with sharp white angular lapels and silver-edged shoulder plates, a deep purple chest panel carrying a bright pink diamond-shaped gem framed by silver spikes, silver studs running down the seams, short black sleeves with silver diamond ornaments and small hanging red crystal drops, white gloves with spiked silver cuffs, tight white trousers with silver diamond plates at the knees, and polished black boots with silver angular trim and a magenta crystal at each cuff
must_keep: the two dark curved dragon horns stay on his head in every shot - never hidden by the hair or the framing, and never replaced by animal ears, antlers or a hat
the eyes are one solid CRIMSON-ROSE RED in BOTH eyes - never blue, green, gold or violet, never two different colours, never a glowing iris
the wings stay folded behind his back and never wrap around the shoulders like a cloak - the outfit has NO hood and NO cape over the shoulders
durin.eye_line: BOTH eyes are clearly visible and are one solid crimson-rose red - never blue, green, gold or violet, never two different colours.

traits.expect: BOTH irises one solid crimson to rose-red colour (a deep red with a slight pink cast is correct). 'wrong' if either iris is blue, green, gold/yellow or clearly violet-purple, if the two eyes differ, if the iris is two-tone, or if the eyes glow. 'unclear' if the eyes are too small, closed or hidden to tell.

one pair of dark-grey SEGMENTED dragon horns that hook backwards like jagged crystalline blades, each with a faint violet-blue inner edge. 'wrong' if there are no horns at all, if the head instead carries animal ears, cat ears, antlers, a hat, a helmet or a headband, or if the horns are smooth, rounded or curled like a ram's horn. 'ok' when only one horn is visible in a strict side or profile view. 'partial' only when the horns are tiny, blunt or clearly simplified from the jagged blade shape in a front or three-quarter view.

short messy pale-LAVENDER hair in layered tufts with long strands framing the face and darker violet tips. 'wrong' if the hair reads as flat short spiky hair with no layered strands, or if its colour is white, silver, blue or brown instead of pale lavender.

a pair of dark bat-like dragon wings with magenta-red membrane visible behind his back, folded behind the shoulders rather than spread wide; in an upper-body or full-body shot the wings must be visible at least as folded shapes at the edges of the back

_example.identity_prompt: long blonde hair in two pigtails with small pointed elf ears, red eyes, a child-like anime face
_example.outfit_prompt: a red hooded coat with a white collar, a broad red hat with a four-leaf clover ornament, white gloves and brown boots
must_keep: the big red hat stays on the head in every shot
